title: 機場流程
description: 在機場辦理各項手續的用語

sentences.en: I would like to check in for my flight to London, which departs at ten forty-five, and I was wondering if there are any window seats still available in the rear section.
sentences.zh: 我想辦理十點四十五分飛往倫敦的班機報到，想問後段是否還有靠窗的座位？

sentences.en: The self-service kiosk informed me that my booking reference could not be found in the system, so the staff directed me to the full-service counter for manual processing.
sentences.zh: 自助報到機顯示系統找不到我的訂位代號，所以工作人員引導我到人工服務櫃台辦理。

sentences.en: Could you please tell me the weight limit for checked baggage on international flights, because my suitcase feels significantly heavier than the last time I traveled?
sentences.zh: 能否請你告訴我國際航班託運行李的重量限制？因為我的行李箱感覺比上次旅行時重很多。

sentences.en: The security officer asked me to remove my laptop, liquids bag, and belt before placing my carry-on luggage on the conveyor belt for the X-ray screening.
sentences.zh: 安檢人員要求我在把隨身行李放上X光檢查輸送帶之前，取出筆電、液體袋和皮帶。

sentences.en: After clearing immigration, where the officer stamped my passport and asked about the purpose of my visit, I proceeded to the departure lounge to wait for boarding.
sentences.zh: 通過入境檢查——官員在我護照上蓋了章並詢問了來訪目的——之後，我前往候機室等待登機。

sentences.en: The departure board shows that our flight has been delayed by approximately two hours due to a technical issue with the aircraft that is currently being resolved.
sentences.zh: 出發看板顯示我們的航班因飛機技術問題延誤約兩小時，目前正在解決中。

sentences.en: I accidentally packed a bottle of water in my carry-on bag, which the security scanner detected, and the officer politely asked me to either drink it or dispose of it.
sentences.zh: 我不小心把一瓶水放在隨身行李裡，安檢掃描器偵測到了，人員禮貌地要求我喝掉或丟棄。

sentences.en: The airline representative at the gate announced that the flight is overbooked, and they are looking for volunteers willing to take a later flight in exchange for compensation.
sentences.zh: 登機門的航空公司代表宣布班機超賣，正在尋找願意改搭較晚班機並換取補償的自願者。

sentences.en: Since I have a three-hour layover between my connecting flights, I was wondering whether I need to go through security again or if I can stay in the transit area.
sentences.zh: 由於我的轉機有三小時的等候時間，我想知道是否需要再次通過安檢，還是可以留在轉機區。

sentences.en: The customs declaration form requires me to list all items purchased abroad whose total value exceeds the duty-free allowance for returning residents.
sentences.zh: 海關申報表要求我列出所有在國外購買且總價值超過回國居民免稅額度的物品。

sentences.en: My luggage did not appear on the carousel after waiting for forty minutes, so I went to the lost baggage counter to file a claim with my baggage receipt tag.
sentences.zh: 等了四十分鐘我的行李沒有出現在轉盤上，所以我拿著行李收據去遺失行李櫃台申報。

sentences.en: The fast-track security lane, which is available to business class passengers and frequent flyer gold members, allows you to bypass the long queue that has formed at the regular checkpoint.
sentences.zh: 快速通關安檢通道開放給商務艙旅客和飛行常客金卡會員，讓你可以跳過一般檢查站排的長隊。

sentences.en: Before proceeding to the gate, I stopped at the duty-free shop to purchase a bottle of perfume, which the cashier sealed in a transparent security bag with the receipt attached.
sentences.zh: 前往登機門之前，我在免稅店買了一瓶香水，收銀員把它密封在附有收據的透明安全袋裡。

sentences.en: The immigration officer noticed that my visa was set to expire in less than two weeks and warned me to make sure I depart the country before the expiration date.
sentences.zh: 入境官員注意到我的簽證不到兩週就過期，並警告我務必在到期日前離境。

sentences.en: I need to declare the electronic equipment I am carrying for business purposes so that I will not be charged import duties when I bring it back into my home country.
sentences.zh: 我需要申報隨身攜帶的商務用電子設備，這樣帶回本國時才不會被課進口關稅。

sentences.en: The airport shuttle bus that connects Terminal One to Terminal Three, where my connecting flight departs from, runs every ten minutes and takes approximately fifteen minutes.
sentences.zh: 連接第一航廈到第三航廈——我的轉機航班從那裡出發——的機場接駁巴士每十分鐘一班，車程約十五分鐘。

sentences.en: Upon arriving at the check-in counter, I was informed that my seat had been upgraded to premium economy because the regular economy section was fully booked on this flight.
sentences.zh: 到達報到櫃台時，我被告知我的座位已升等至豪華經濟艙，因為這班飛機的一般經濟艙已客滿。

sentences.en: The electronic gates for automated passport control were temporarily out of service, which meant everyone had to queue for the manned immigration booths instead.
sentences.zh: 自動護照查驗的電子閘門暫時停止服務，這意味著所有人都必須改排人工入境查驗窗口。

sentences.en: I was asked to step aside for a random secondary screening, during which an officer thoroughly inspected my carry-on bag and asked me several questions about my travel itinerary.
sentences.zh: 我被要求到一旁接受隨機二次安檢，期間一位人員徹底檢查了我的隨身行李並問了幾個關於旅行行程的問題。

sentences.en: The overhead bins near my assigned seat were completely full by the time I boarded, so the flight attendant offered to store my bag in a compartment several rows behind.
sentences.zh: 等我登機時，我指定座位附近的頭頂置物櫃已經全滿了，所以空服員提議把我的包放在後面幾排的置物櫃。

sentences.en: To expedite the boarding process, the airline called passengers by zone numbers printed on their boarding passes, starting with those seated at the back of the aircraft.
sentences.zh: 為了加快登機流程，航空公司按登機證上印的區域號碼叫號，從坐在飛機後方的乘客開始。

sentences.en: The arrivals hall was extremely crowded with people holding name signs and flowers, waiting eagerly for their family members who were returning from abroad after several years.
sentences.zh: 入境大廳擠滿了舉著名牌和鮮花的人，熱切地等待他們在國外多年後歸來的家人。

sentences.en: Because my passport is expiring within six months, several countries on my itinerary may refuse entry, so I need to apply for a renewal before my departure date.
sentences.zh: 因為我的護照將在六個月內到期，行程中的幾個國家可能拒絕入境，所以我需要在出發日前申請換發。

sentences.en: The baggage reclaim area for our flight is carousel number seven, which is located on the lower level of the arrivals hall past the escalators on the left.
sentences.zh: 我們航班的行李提領區是七號轉盤，位於入境大廳下層，經過左邊的手扶梯。

sentences.en: I strongly suggest arriving at least three hours before an international departure, especially during holiday seasons when security lines and check-in queues tend to be exceptionally long.
sentences.zh: 我強烈建議在國際航班出發前至少三小時到達，特別是在假日期間安檢和報到隊伍往往特別長。

sentences.en: The currency exchange booth located after customs clearance offered a slightly better rate than the one in the departure area, which is something worth noting for future travelers.
sentences.zh: 通過海關後的貨幣兌換櫃台匯率比出發區的稍好一些，這對未來的旅客來說值得注意。

sentences.en: After landing, the captain reminded passengers to remain seated with their seatbelts fastened until the aircraft had come to a complete stop and the fasten seatbelt sign was turned off.
sentences.zh: 降落後，機長提醒乘客在飛機完全停妥且繫安全帶燈號熄滅前，請繫好安全帶坐在座位上。

sentences.en: The airport lounge, which offers complimentary refreshments, showers, and sleeping pods, is accessible to passengers holding premium tickets or those with qualifying credit cards.
sentences.zh: 機場貴賓室提供免費餐點、淋浴和睡眠艙，持有頭等艙或商務艙機票的旅客或擁有符合資格信用卡者可進入。

sentences.en: I was relieved to discover that the airport provides free luggage trolleys near the arrival carousel, because my two heavy suitcases would have been impossible to carry alone.
sentences.zh: 我很慶幸發現機場在行李轉盤附近提供免費手推車，因為我那兩個沉重的行李箱不可能獨自搬運。

sentences.en: The ground staff member, who noticed I was struggling to find my gate, kindly escorted me through the terminal and made sure I reached the correct boarding area in time.
sentences.zh: 一位注意到我找不到登機門的地勤人員，親切地帶我穿過航廈，確保我及時到達正確的登機區域。
